messages:
tess_csm: Heads-up — Pioneer tenant goes live tomorrow 09:00 PT. I put together a tiny safety-net miniguide (prefill, warm caches, batching/stream fallbacks, renewal-watch). Pls ack and add any quick ops/TE steps.

omar_sre: Ack. Ops notes: prefill top-10 prompts into KV, warm cache_ttl=30s. Start with batching OFF for first 5m, then enable batch_size=4 and batch_window_ms=200. If p50 latency > 350ms after a step -> set batch_size=1 and disable streaming. Page if p95 > 1s for 10m.

li_te: Runtime flags we'll expose to CSMs:
```yaml
tenant_toggle:
  enable_streaming: true
  initial_batch_size: 0
  batch_window_ms: 200
  cache_ttl_seconds: 30
  kv_prefix: pioneer/$TENANT
```
Quick smoke curl for streaming handshake to include in onboarding script:
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"pioneer-v1","stream":true,"input":"ping"}' | jq .stream_open
Expect true, else fallback path engages.

zara_pm: Renewal-watch rule suggestion: if day-3 DAU < 12% forecast AND avg_error_rate > 1.5% over 4h -> create renewal_flag and CSM outreach within 12h. CSM pre-call checklist: confirm keys, verify prefill KV count, run streaming smoke, note any fallback model usage.

runbook-bot: deploy: onboarding-safety-net rolled to staging @ 2026-06-03T02:14:00Z - smoke tests passed.

tess_csm: Thanks all. Action items: I will send kickoff email with a 1-question latency poll, li add curl to onboarding script, omar add on-call fallback snippet to runbook, zara add renewal-watch rule to alerts. I'll monitor metrics first 24h and post flags here. :eyes:
